---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## ✨ Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Problem / Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the use case it addresses.

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
[e.g., "I'm always frustrated when..."]

## 🎯 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or features? Describe them here.

## 📸 Mockups / Examples

If applicable, add mockups, sketches, or examples from other websites.

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria

What would need to be true for this feature to be considered complete?

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 📝 Additional Context

Add any other context, links, or information about the feature request here.

## 🎨 Design Considerations

Are there any specific design or UX considerations?

## ⚡ Priority

How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Would be helpful
- [ ] Important
- [ ] Critical

## 🔗 Related Issues

Link any related issues or PRs here using #issue_number.
